Messages.Author: Nikolaj "Lord of the Betrayers" Wendt
Messages.Body:


I had a deck once with Democritus/Anson together with multiple copies
of Anarch Troublemaker + Prophecies of Gehenna. You put them in play,
and when you have another copy in your hand, you "activate" it and
pass it to your prey. Then you play your next one. People usually dont
want to pay 2 pool for the contest, so they yield and you get to do
the same next turn. Anthelios goes in there as well of course, and
there is a nice synergy between Anson and Demo discpline wise as well.

I was actually thinking of rebuilding it, and I think I will do that.
There must be a lot of new potential good cards to put in.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 17 Sep 2009 18:05:33 -0700, "Kevin M." wrote:

>> I ran Ventrue HQ and Elysium: PV which, while not extremely popular,
>> are very abusable with House of Sorrow.

>I thought this was recently ruled that as they contain "During..." that
>they are not reusable via House of Sorrow?

They can always be untapped via House of Sorrow.

If the card uses "During X, tap to Y", you can only do it once each X,
even if the card is untapped.

Getting two use Ventrue Headquarters or Elysium: The Palace of
Versailles twice on the same turn may enable an oust now, instead of
an oust later, so it can still be a good choice to untap them with
House of Sorrows.

Carpe noctem.
